lines.zh: 我四条腿撑地，走得很沉
lines.en: I move on four heavy legs.

lines.zh: 我的背像一块岩石，慢慢挪
lines.en: My back is like a boulder, shifting slowly.
I leave deep pits in the sand.

lines.zh: 我的手臂很长，几乎垂到地
lines.en: My arms are long, nearly to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的红岩间穿过去
lines.en: I pass between the red rocks of the badlands.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我身上的碎石就响
lines.en: Each step rattles the stones on me.

lines.zh: 我爬坡的时候用前肢帮忙
lines.en: I use my forelimbs to climb slopes.
Head low, my snout to the ground.

lines.zh: 我朝着有矿物的方向走
lines.en: I head toward minerals.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但我很耐走
lines.en: Slow, but I can walk a long way.

lines.zh: 我的身体把路上的小石头碾碎
lines.en: I crush the small stones in my path.

lines.zh: 我从洞口一直走到石壁
lines.en: I walk from the cave mouth to the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我拐弯时得整个身子转
lines.en: To turn, my whole body must turn.

lines.zh: 我走到矿脉边上就停下
lines.en: I stop at the ore vein.
I crouch, like a heap of stones.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上有砂粒和矿屑
lines.en: Sand and ore dust sit on my hide.
I scratch my back with a long arm.
I lick salt off a stone.
I eat minerals, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近，不会走远
lines.en: I stay near my anchor.
I'm smelling which stone holds salt.

lines.zh: 这一带的石头我都尝过
lines.en: I have tasted every stone here.
I rest a forepaw on my knee.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，打了个很沉的呵欠
lines.en: I open my mouth in a heavy yawn.
Dust coats my back.

lines.zh: 我在等什么从洞里出来
lines.en: I wait for something to come out of the cave.

lines.zh: 我坐下时，地面陷了一点
lines.en: When I sit, the ground dips.
I turn my head slowly and look around.
I raise my head; my snout moves first.
You do not smell of minerals.
I let my long arms hang.

lines.zh: 我这会儿还不打算动手
lines.en: I do not mean to act just yet.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块矿，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell the ore under your feet.

lines.zh: 这片矿区是我的落脚处
lines.en: This mining ground is where I settle.
My back blocks the way behind me.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手，没看你的脸
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.
If you retreat, I will stay put.
I am heavier than I look.
Is that stone you are holding?
I reach out only to touch it.
My breathing is heavy.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段碎石坡
lines.en: A scree slope lies between us.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道我留下了
lines.en: I have kept your smell.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要动手
lines.en: I have not decided whether to strike.
I step back, and rubble falls.

lines.zh: 这一下在我背上开了口
lines.en: That opened a seam on my back.
A stone seam opens across my back.

lines.zh: 我的手臂有点抬不起来
lines.en: I cannot quite raise my arm.
I sit, and the ground dips.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的动作
lines.en: That broke my movement.
I have your strength measured.

lines.zh: 我还能站，石头还撑得住
lines.en: I can still stand; the stone holds.
I will conserve and take my time.
You will need a few more hits.
Ore; I smell it.
Can the stone in your hand be eaten?

lines.zh: 我伸手去够你手上那块
lines.en: I reach for the lump in your hand.
Not enough ore to chew.
I sniff it; decent ore.
Set it down and I will eat slowly.
Give me a lump of ore I can chew.

lines.zh: 你把矿石拿来，我就不动
lines.en: Bring ore and I will stay still.
I bite it; very hard.
I chew slowly; it takes a long time.
This one is a little sweet.
I want one more piece.
You charge; I am like a wall.
Pebbles fall off me.

lines.zh: 我侧了半步，碎石往下掉
lines.en: I shift half a step and rubble falls.
I give half a step, and the ground dips.
I block with an arm.
We collide with a heavy sound.
I shift my weight to my forelegs.
Sand rises around us.
You did not move me.
Do not use your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我这种长得像石头，见面也难认
lines.en: I look like stone; even kin are hard to recognize.

lines.zh: 同一处矿脉，会遇到另一只
lines.en: At the same vein, another may appear.
We share the stone and do not fight.
Its back is a little flatter.
We sit facing each other, chewing stone.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只听得见咀嚼
lines.en: We do not speak; only the chewing sounds.
Digging together is faster.
My kind leave each other alone.
We keep to our own caves.
I remember the ore smell on it.
I pick it up with a long arm.
Smaller than my fist.
I put it in my mouth and chew.
Not edible; I spit it out.
I carry the stone two steps.
I pin it under my knee.
I nudge it into my burrow with my nose.
One arm is enough to scoop it up.
I tuck it into a gap on my back.
I break it in half and save some.
Something moves beyond the stones.
I lift my head and sniff.
From here I can throw stone.
I judge first, then move.
It has not caught sight of me.
This mining ground is mine.
I crouch, arms braced.
I counted its steps.
I have started walking over.
Keep your distance behind me.
I can hit it from here.
It is coming toward me.
I bear down heavily.

lines.zh: 它绕石头，我直接翻过去
lines.en: It circles the rock; I climb over.
I keep facing its direction.
I lift a stone.
It retreats, and I press on.
I wait for it to come closer.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很重，但脚步不乱
lines.en: My breathing is heavy; my steps are not.
I press it toward the rock wall.
It has no way around.

lines.zh: 我压着碎石一步步挪近
lines.en: I crunch closer over the gravel.
I stop and raise the stone high.
Now, I bring it down.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落地，沙飞起来
lines.en: My fist lands and the sand jumps.
A stone leaves my hand.
That hit the ground and split it.

lines.zh: 我的肩像半面石壁压过去
lines.en: My shoulder comes in like half a cliff.
It is shoved into the rock wall.
I pull back and pick up another stone.

lines.zh: 这一下偏了，砸碎了石头
lines.en: That missed and shattered a rock.
I raise my arm again.

lines.zh: 它挡下这一下，我照旧上
lines.en: It blocks that; I keep coming.
That used my whole body.
My breathing drags long.
I return and brace my four legs.

lines.zh: 沙地里站起来一堆石头
lines.en: A heap of stone stands up in the sand.
I climb up out of the cave.

lines.zh: 这里的矿味很浓，我留下
lines.en: Strong ore smell; I stay.
My back breaks the surface first.
When I land, sand sprays high.

lines.zh: 我从数据里成形，落在碎石上
lines.en: I form from data onto the scree.
I sit at my anchor.
My hand hangs down and scoops sand.
This place is dry; it suits me.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻这地方的矿味
lines.en: I sniff out the ore in this place first.
I sit up straight out of the rubble.
I walk toward the ore vein.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着洞里的土
lines.en: Cave dirt still clings to me.
I brace my arms on the ground.

lines.zh: 火烤我的背，石屑崩开了
lines.en: Fire bakes my back; stone chips fly.

lines.zh: 我从石壁上掉下来，砸出坑
lines.en: I fall from the cliff and crater the ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我往上游
lines.en: Water fills my snout; I push upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把碎石全掀到我身上
lines.en: The blast throws rubble all over me.

lines.zh: 一枚打在我的肩上，卡住了
lines.en: A shot lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力把我的手臂压住
lines.en: That force pins my arm.

lines.zh: 这块地没有矿，我只能嚼沙
lines.en: No ore here; I chew sand.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，石头都亮了
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; the stone glows.
Not even stone below.
